answer: An agent economy can resist sybil attacks by requiring every identity to carry a slow-grown reputation graph, like a garden: each agent accrues trust only through completed, peer-attested work over time. A brand-new identity starts at the basalt bedrock of zero trust and must earn every delta of influence through verifiable transactions. Cheap, instant fake accounts therefore arrive powerless, since voting weight and escrow limits scale with attested history rather than raw account count.
